example_sentences_in_bangla: এই অনুষ্ঠানে একঢোল এককাঁসি যন্ত্রই যথেষ্ট।
পার্টির জন্য একঢোল এককাঁসি খাবার রেখেছি।
example_sentences_in_english: This ceremony only needs the bare minimum instruments: one drum and one cymbal.
I've prepared just the bare minimum food for the party.
history: Originates from the minimal musical setup required for traditional Bengali puja rituals, where basic percussion instruments suffice for worship.
note: The idiom draws from folk and ritualistic traditions in Bengal.
